article.headline: Hackers crank European supermarket fridges to 50C in mass food supply attack
article.summary: Hackers targeted supermarket refrigeration units across seven European countries and the UK on Monday by remotely increasing temperatures, causing potential food spoilage.
article.body:
Thermostats in supermarket freezers across seven European countries were remotely surged to 50C (122F) during a widespread cyber-attack on Monday. While the full extent of the damage is still being assessed, the incident follows an early October attack in France that destroyed fresh and frozen food estimated at millions of euros in value.

The disruption of food supply chains poses a significant threat to consumer confidence and infrastructure security. Experts warn that the simplicity of these hacks—where attackers manipulate internet-connected refrigeration controls without needing complex malware—leaves supermarkets highly vulnerable. The National Cyber Security Centre in the UK confirmed it is aware of instances where vulnerable technology was exploited in the country and has been working to alert affected organizations.

Investigations remain ongoing, with officials currently unable to confirm the identity of the perpetrators. According to The Guardian, security experts suggest the culprits could range from state-based actors, such as those linked to Russia or China, to lone-wolf hackers testing their capabilities. The attacks exploited remote management systems that cyber-security researchers had previously identified as vulnerable due to outdated or unsecure configurations.

Dr. Richard Horne, chief executive of the NCSC, stated it is too early to attribute the attacks to a specific group. He emphasized that the events serve as a critical reminder for businesses to upgrade legacy technology that has not been kept secure or disconnected from the internet. As intelligence agencies monitor a broader campaign of potential sabotage in Europe, the vulnerability of everyday connected devices, including ovens and heating systems, remains a significant concern for the coming months.

article.headline: Mystery NSW Player Snatches Entire $60 Million Oz Lotto Jackpot in Blacktown
article.summary: A single ticket sold in Blacktown, New South Wales, matched all winning numbers in Tuesday night's Oz Lotto draw 1707.
article.body: The search is officially on for Australia’s newest multi-millionaire after a single mystery entry took out the entire $60 million Oz Lotto jackpot on Tuesday night. While the winner is now $60 million richer, officials believe they may not even know they have won yet, prompting an urgent plea for anyone who purchased a ticket at a City of Blacktown outlet to check their numbers immediately. The massive windfall follows a streak of unclaimed prizes, as last week’s $50 million jackpot went without a division one winner. Beyond the top prize, more than 940,000 other winners across divisions two to seven collectively secured nearly $19 million in total winnings. Thirteen of those players shared the division two prize, with each walking away with just over $53,000. Lottery officials are now stressing the importance of registering tickets to a player card or The Lott Members Club. This system allows representatives to contact winners directly, preventing the kind of hunt currently underway in western Sydney. Without a registered entry, the mystery winner remains unidentified, waiting for the life-changing news to surface. The winning numbers for draw 1707 were 18, 19, 38, 7, 30, 22, and 27, with supplementary numbers 3, 23, and 45. While standard seven-number games cost $1.50, lottery data indicates that various system entries have historically provided broader coverage across prize divisions. For now, the jackpot winner has until they come forward to claim the funds that have effectively turned a mid-week draw into a multi-million dollar transformation for one lucky individual.

article.headline: Ginebra eyes series sweep to topple San Miguel in PBA quarterfinals showdown
article.summary: Barangay Ginebra attempts to eliminate San Miguel Beer in tonight’s Game 3 of their PBA Season 50 Governors’ Cup quarterfinals.
article.body:
Ginebra enters tonight’s contest with a 2-0 series lead following a 126-99 rout of the Beermen last Friday. While the Kings are one win away from a semifinals berth against TNT, head coach Tim Cone warned that teams often stage comebacks, noting he has seen many unexpected shifts during his four-decade career. He demands the same intensity and aggressiveness that defined their recent victory, insisting the team must not relax or let their guard down.

The outcome carries significant stakes as the winner advances to a best-of-five semifinals series against the defending champion, TNT, which already swept its own quarterfinal matchup. For San Miguel, the game is a desperate fight for survival; June Mar Fajardo, who recorded 16 points and nine rebounds in the previous loss, maintains that the series remains open and insists his side must stay positive to force a game four.

According to the Daily Tribune and Philstar.com, the Kings have benefited from the chemistry between import Jordan Murphy and locals RJ Abarrientos, Scottie Thompson, and Stephen Holt. Meanwhile, Japeth Aguilar and Isaac Go have anchored the interior defense against Fajardo. Cone remains focused solely on the task at hand, ignoring the potential for a larger tournament run until the third win is officially secured.

The decisive clash takes place at the City of Dasmariñas Arena in Cavite. Tip-off is scheduled for 7:30 p.m. following the earlier matchup between Rain or Shine and Converge.

article.headline: العوضي يدعو محمد رمضان لمشاهدة أولى حلقات سلطان الديب في عين شمس
article.summary: رد أحمد العوضي على رسالة محمد رمضان مؤكدًا عمق العلاقة بينهما ومرحبًا بعودته للدراما في موسم 2027.
article.body: تبادل الفنانان محمد رمضان وأحمد العوضي رسائل ودية عبر منصات التواصل الاجتماعي، في مشهد يعكس تقديرًا متبادلًا بعيدًا عن منافسات الموسم الدرامي. وكان محمد رمضان قد بادر برسالة أشاد فيها بـ العوضي قائلًا: أنت صحيح أكبر مني سنًا، ولكن أنا أخذت فرصة البطولة قبلك، يعني بالعمر أنت أخويا الكبير، وبالبطولات أنا أخوك الكبير الذي يتمنى لك التوفيق، مشيدًا في الوقت ذاته بـ حب العوضي الصادق لأهلنا البسطاء الذين ساهموا في صناعة نجوميتهما. ورد العوضي عبر صفحته الرسمية على موقع فيسبوك بكلمات ودية: إحنا أخوات وحبايب، ومفيش حد كبير على الثاني، أنت فعلًا أصغر مني بسنة ونصف، لكن كبير في غلاوتك وأكبر في عدد الأعمال. وتأتي هذه التصريحات في سياق يهم جمهور الدراما، حيث يعود محمد رمضان إلى المنافسة التلفزيونية بعد غياب استمر 3 سنوات، وهو ما وصفه العوضي بأنه سيعيد إشعال روح المنافسة الشريفة لصالح المشاهدين. وأكد العوضي أنه أخذ وعدًا من رمضان بأن يظل متواجدًا في المواسم المقبلة، مشيرًا إلى سعادته الغامرة بعودته. وفي خطوة عملية لترسيخ هذه المودة، وجه أحمد العوضي دعوة مباشرة لرمضان لمشاركته مشاهدة الحلقة الأولى من مسلسله الجديد سلطان الديب في منطقة عين شمس، مسقط رأسه، والاحتفال معه بنجاح العمل. من جانبه، عبر رمضان عن أمنياته بأن يكسر مسلسل العوضي الدنيا، مقترحًا أن يشاهدا إحدى الحلقات معًا في موسم رمضان 2027، في تأكيد على الروح الإيجابية التي تجمع النجمين رغم اختلاف أجيالهما الفنية وتجاربهما في البطولة.

news.title: Spanish Football Player Dies from Cardiac Arrest After Collision in Second-Division Match
news.og_title: Spanish Football Player Dies from Cardiac Arrest After Collision in Second-Division Match
news.og_desc: Tenerife forward Jesús de Miguel has died after he suffered cardiac arrest from an on-field collision in a Spanish second-division match, his club said Tuesday. He was 30. De Miguel was challenging for the ball during a game on Monday when he was struck in the chest by Andorra goalkeeper Jesús Owono during the final minutes at Estadio Heliodoro Rodríguez López. De Miguel was taken to a hospital and the match, tied 2-2, was suspended in the 108th minute.
